what.title: What is OmniConsole?
body: OmniConsole runs as the Windows 11 XBOX Mode (FSE) Home shell on PCs and handhelds (ROG Xbox Ally X, etc.), with an OmniCharm Game Bar widget, Steam shortcuts, and Nekomata Mode to turn your gamepad into keyboard and mouse, tailored per app, so everything stays on the gamepad.

Whenever XBOX Mode (FSE) activates, OmniConsole launches your configured gaming platform. Any platform can be your XBOX Mode (FSE) Home — Steam, XBOX, Epic, Armoury Crate SE, Playnite, or anything you add.

entries.title: Boot
entries.body: Auto-launch into your configured platform (requires "Enter XBOX mode (FSE) on startup" enabled).

entries.title: XBOX Button
entries.body: Opens Game Bar — pick "Home" to launch the platform, or "Library" to open OmniConsole settings.

entries.title: Start Menu
entries.body: Launch OmniConsole from the desktop; XBOX Mode (FSE) is triggered automatically before the platform starts.

what.resultOutFse: Trigger XBOX Mode (FSE) dialog → Re-launch in XBOX Mode (FSE) → Launch configured platform

mouseMode.title: Nekomata Mode
mouseMode.description: Turn your controller into a mouse and keyboard, customizable per app. Nekomata weaves a charm for each app, remapping XInput controls to keyboard, mouse, or cursor actions, and can raise mapping priority with Nekomata Boost, add hold-to-repeat, and prevent double input. Three layouts to start from: OmniNav, Classic, or a Custom layout you define yourself (Pro). OmniNav shown below — common keys only; tap the link below for the full reference.
mouseMode.imageAlt: XBOX controller with the left stick moving a cursor on a laptop and the A button highlighted as click
mouseMode.footnote: On / Off toggle. When on, your customized profiles take over; built-in mapping covers Edge, Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Brave, Epic Games Store, EA Desktop, Playnite Desktop, File Explorer, the Windows file picker, the Open with dialog, Windows Installer, Steam, Discord, App Installer, and a wide range of built-in Windows tools and Control Panel dialogs (also customizable). Those that run as Administrator, such as Task Manager, and the On-screen keyboard also require Administrator App Support (Pro). On the ROG Ally family, which has built-in gamepad mapping, Nekomata Mode stays out of the way; Pro can turn it on for those consoles.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to make your gaming PC feel like a console.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prerequisites.subtitle: OmniConsole needs Windows 11 24H2 (Build 26100.7019) or later, with the Full Handheld edition of XBOX Mode (FSE) enabled.

desktop.title: Desktops / Laptops / Tablets / Handhelds without the Full Handheld edition
desktop.body: Microsoft is gradually rolling out a Limited PC edition of XBOX Mode (FSE) to regular PCs. Use Xbox Full Screen Experience Tool to switch to the Full Handheld edition first.

native.title: Native XBOX Mode (FSE) Handheld Devices
native.body: Devices like the ROG Xbox Ally series ship with the Full Handheld edition. Install OmniConsole directly.

controller.title: XBOX Controller Required
controller.body: Game Bar, XBOX Mode (FSE), and gamepad features all require an XBOX-compatible (XInput) controller with an XBOX button.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.subtitle: Four steps to turn your PC into a gaming console.

step1.title: Install OmniConsole
step1.body: Download the latest release and run Install.bat, or manually install the .cer certificate and both .msix packages.

step2.title: Configure Your Default Platform
step2.body: Open OmniConsole Settings, pick Steam Big Picture / XBOX / Epic / Armoury Crate SE / Playnite, or add a custom one.

step3.title: Set as XBOX Mode (FSE) Home App
step3.body: Windows Settings → Gaming → XBOX mode (FSE) → Choose home app → OmniConsole. Enable "Enter XBOX mode (FSE) on startup".

step4.title: Done
step4.body: Reboot, press the XBOX button and pick "Home", or launch from the Start Menu — your platform opens automatically.
